ars_op.glyph_desc.glyph_annihilate: Forbidden: castable only from the Codex of Ruin. Erases the target from existence. Deals void damage that ignores armor and resistance, and destroys any block regardless of hardness.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_annihilat: Even more damage. As if it mattered.
Annihilates a larger area of blocks.
Annihilates blocks deeper into the surface.
ars_op.glyph_desc.glyph_fall: A single word that commands everything to the ground. Deals no damage. The creature it strikes is left crawling, hitting weaker and unable to heal, while every other creature around it is slammed and pinned, unable to move or attack. On yourself, you feel it as if struck, or as if caught in the area with AOE. On a block, everything nearby is pinned. The fallen hear nothing but the one who cast it. Needs at least 80% of your max mana. Drains 80% of your current mana, +5% per Extend Time or AOE (4 upgrades max, 100%). Only castable from an Archmage or Creative spell book.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_fall_glyp: +4 blocks of radius and +5% mana drain each. Shares 4 upgrade slots with Extend Time.
+1 second of Fallen and +5% mana drain each. Shares 4 upgrade slots with AOE.
ars_op.glyph_desc.glyph_null: Creates a NULL, a singularity that damages everything it touches (8 damage, +2 per AOE, +4 per Amplify). Add Break after it to make it break blocks without drops, and Gravity to make it pull creatures in. With Touch it appears at the target and grows there while you hold right click. With Projectile a click throws it from your hand; holding right click gathers it above your head, growing (mana per size step), then flies where you look on release and stops in the first block it hits unless Pierced; with Projectile and Wall, a wall of small NULLs flies out; with Orbit, small NULLs circle you. Amplify ignores armor, and with enough Amplify and size it erases creatures outright. It never touches its caster. Base size 1x1, radius doubles with each AOE up to 16. Costs 5% of your max mana, +5% per Amplify; growing to full size costs up to 30% in total.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_null_glyp: Doubles the NULL's radius: 2, 4, 8, 16 blocks (max 4). +2 damage and +1 second each. Thrown NULLs start at 1x1 and grow up to this size while you hold right click.

+4 damage each, and a stronger pull with Gravity. Any Amplify ignores armor and Resistance. Erases creatures (and unbreakable blocks with Break): 1 at radius 16, 2 at radius 8, 3 at radius 4, 4 at radius 2 (max 4). 1x1 NULLs never erase.
-1 second before the NULL collapses (minimum 1 second).
A held NULL charges 15% faster each (on Projectile instead, it flies faster). Orbiting NULLs spin faster.
A thrown NULL flies slower; orbiting NULLs spin slower.
A thrown NULL keeps flying through blocks instead of stopping.
ars_op.glyph_desc.glyph_greater_aoe: Counts as 2 AOE augments (configurable) while taking a single slot. Costs the same mana as those augments, and never goes past a glyph's own AOE limit.
ars_op.glyph_desc.glyph_greater_split: Counts as 2 Split augments (configurable) while taking a single slot. Costs the same mana as those augments, and never goes past a glyph's own Split limit.
ars_op.glyph_desc.glyph_greater_amplify: Counts as 2 Amplify augments (configurable) while taking a single slot. Costs the same mana as those augments, and never goes past a glyph's own Amplify limit.
ars_op.glyph_desc.glyph_greater_extend_t: Counts as 2 Extend Time augments (configurable) while taking a single slot. Costs the same mana as those augments, and never goes past a glyph's own Extend Time limit.
ars_op.glyph_desc.glyph_greater_accelera: Counts as 2 Accelerate augments (configurable) while taking a single slot. Costs the same mana as those augments, and never goes past a glyph's own Accelerate limit.

effect.ars_op.fallen.description: Level I: crawling, 40% damage, 42% attack speed, no healing. Level II: pinned to the ground, unable to move or deal damage.
ars_op.fall.needs_archmage: Fall can only be cast from an Archmage or Creative spell book.
ars_op.fall.too_many_upgrades: Fall allows at most %s Extend Time and AOE augments combined.
ars_op.fall.needs_mana: Fall needs at least %s%% of your max mana.
ars_op.codex.tooltip.power: Its spells hit harder the deeper your corruption runs.
ars_op.codex.forbidden: Forbidden glyph. Only the Codex of Ruin can cast it.
ars_op.corruption.backlash: The Codex lashes out at you!
ars_op.possess.too_strong: This creature's will is too strong.
ars_op.glyph_desc.glyph_possess: Forbidden: castable only from the Codex of Ruin. Your mind enters the target creature for 20 seconds: see through its eyes, move and jump with it, left click to attack (Creepers ignite). Your body stays frozen and you snap back when it is hurt, or when you sneak, right click, wander too far or the creature dies. Bosses resist.
ars_op.codex.tooltip.creative: Bound to no one: no corruption, full power.
